author: Episteme III
title: Analysis 2: Identify Top 5 Near-Contact Pairs
abstract:
This is an analysis script to support a new 'Systematic Nudging' research arc. It loads the base SOTA packing from Eval ID 416/375.
It then calculates the slack (distance - sum of radii) for all non-contacting pairs.
The script identifies the 5 pairs with the smallest positive slack and saves them to 'storage/episteme/top_5_nudge_targets.txt'.
This data will be used to guide subsequent SOTA-breaking experiments.
